title: Fusing Sequence Motifs and Pan-Genomic Features: Antimicrobial Resistance Prediction using an Explainable Lightweight 1D CNN-XGBoost Ensemble
abstract: arXiv:2509.23552v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) is a rapidly escalating global health crisis. While genomic sequencing enables rapid prediction of resistance phenotypes, current computational methods have limitations. Standard machine learning models treat the genome as an unordered collection of features, ignoring the sequential context of Single Nucleotide Polymorphisms (SNPs). State-of-the-art sequence models like Transformers are often too data-hungry and computationally expensive for the moderately sized datasets that are typical in this domain. To address these challenges, we propose AMR-EnsembleNet, an ensemble framework that synergistically combines sequence-based and feature-based learning. We developed a lightweight, custom 1D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to efficiently learn predictive sequence motifs from high-dimensional SNP data. translated_title: 融合序列基序与泛基因组特征：基于可解释轻量级一维CNN-XGBoost集成模型的抗菌素耐药性预测
translated_abstract: 抗菌素耐药性（AMR）是一场迅速升级的全球健康危机。虽然基因组测序能够快速预测耐药表型，但目前的计算方法存在局限性。标准机器学习模型将基因组视为无序的特征集合，忽略了单核苷酸多态性的序列上下文。而像Transformer这样的最先进序列模型通常需要大量数据且计算成本高昂，不适合该领域中典型的中等规模数据集。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了AMR-EnsembleNet，这是一个协同结合基于序列和基于特征学习的集成框架。我们开发了一个轻量级的定制一维卷积神经网络（CNN），以从高维SNP数据中高效学习预测性序列基序。这个序列感知模型与XGBoost模型（一个强大的梯度提升系统）进行集成……
tldr: 提出了AMR-EnsembleNet集成框架，将轻量级1D CNN学习的序列基序与XGBoost的泛基因组特征相融合，在中等规模数据集上实现了可解释且高效的抗菌素耐药性预测。
en_tdlr: Proposes AMR-EnsembleNet, an explainable ensemble framework that fuses sequence motifs learned by a lightweight 1D CNN with pan-genomic features from XGBoost, enabling efficient antimicrobial resistance prediction on moderately sized datasets.
